    • notifyAppsNeedingAudioRoutingChanged

      public void notifyAppsNeedingAudioRoutingChanged(int... appUids)
      Notifies the active virtual audio session that the set of app UIDs needing audio routing has changed, triggering creation (when appUids is non-empty) or release (when empty) of the backing AudioRecord and/or AudioTrack streams.

      Must be called after starting audio capture or injection via VirtualAudioDevice. Creating the backing audio streams requires Manifest.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_ROUTING to be granted on the context (for VirtualDeviceParams.DEVICE_POLICY_CUSTOM audio policy, grant the permission for this virtual device's getDeviceId()).
